title: Mammography — Minimum Requirements
notes: Section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 34) — see the common all-institutions module; not repeated as items here.

items.requirement: Mammography room space requirement is at least 12 square meters, with patient gowning area with safe storage for valuables and clothing immediately accessible to the room.

measurement.expected: at least 12 square meters as stated

items.requirement: Door to the mammography room should be with interlock to prevent interruption of scanning procedure.
Warning light with wording "X-RAY IN USE, DO NOT ENTER".
Each X-ray room shall include a shielded control alcove. For mammography machines with built-in shielding for the operator, the alcove shall be permitted to be omitted if approved by FANR.
items.alternatives: the shielded control alcove may be omitted for mammography machines with built-in operator shielding, if approved by FANR
items.reviewReason: The manual states omission is permitted 'if approved by FANR'; elsewhere in the same imaging chapter (page 31) shielding compliance is referenced to RPAZ. The approving authority named here appears inconsistent with the rest of the manual.
